title: 낙동강수계관리위원회규정 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Secretariat)
(1) The Committee shall have a secretariat.
(2) Secretariat staff shall comprise:
1. Public officials of the Nakdong River Basin Environmental Office and Daegu Regional Environmental Office appointed by the chairperson;
2. Public officials and employees dispatched from relevant agencies;
3. Persons necessary for the secretariat's work, including financial or accounting experts, appointed by the chairperson.
(3) Staff under paragraph (2) 1 shall concurrently hold positions in the secretariat and the Nakdong River Basin Environmental Office or Daegu Regional Environmental Office.
(4) The head of the secretariat shall be appointed by the chairperson from among the staff under paragraph (2).
